Europe Endures Severe Heatwave, Shattering Records and Causing Fatalities

A severe heatwave has gripped Europe, leading to record-breaking temperatures in several countries including Germany, Poland, the Czech Republic, and Austria. Scientists attribute the intensity and early arrival of the heatwave to climate change. The extreme heat has caused significant disruptions to infrastructure and services, and has been linked to over a thousand deaths in France alone, prompting health alerts and emergency measures.
